LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT BRADEN MERRICK'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS GRANTED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTI0N 3 BECAUSE PLAINTIFF CANNOT SUE INDIVIDUALLY TO RECOVER A CORPORATE OPPORTUNITY. MOTION FOR SUMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED AS TO CAUSES OF ACTION 1 AND 6 BECAUSE PLAINTIFF HAS RAISED A TRIABLE ISSUE OF MATERIAL FACT AS TO DEFENDANT'S FAILURE TO DISCLOSE THE PRODUCTION AGREEMENT. AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION 2, THE MOTION CONCERNING STANDING IS CONSTRUED AS A MOTION FOR JUDGMENT OF THE PLEADINGS AND GRANTED WITH 5 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND FOR PLAINTIFF TO PLEAD A CLAIM BASED ON HIS AGREEING TO A 90/10 SPLIT. DEFENDANT'S COUNSEL IS TO MEET AND CONFER WITH OPPOSING COUNSEL ON THE FORM OF ORDER THAT COMPLES WITH CCP 437C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR #8189
